title: Internal CSS — Styling Inside the HTML File

blocks.content: Course: CSS Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
Internal CSS — Styling Inside the HTML File
What it is:CSS written inside a <style> tag within the HTML file.
Where it lives: Inside the <head> section of the HTML.

items: Styles apply to the entire page
CSS is still locked to a single HTML file

blocks.content: Okay for small demos or learning experiments. Not ideal once a project has multiple pages or components.
